name: Jalna–Nanded Expressway
history: This expressway is a branch off the Samruddhi Mahamarg. The main Mumbai–Nagpur expressway passes through Jalna, and this link runs south-east from there through Parbhani to Nanded, bringing the Marathwada districts onto the same fast road. Nanded is a major pilgrimage city — the Hazur Sahib gurdwara draws visitors from across the country — and the link cuts hours off the drive from Mumbai.
facts: A branch of the Samruddhi Mahamarg, joining it at Jalna.
Brings Nanded and Parbhani within a fast road journey of both Mumbai and Nagpur.
Nanded is home to Hazur Sahib, one of the five takhts of Sikhism.
Built by the Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation, the same agency as the Samruddhi Mahamarg.
significance: Marathwada is one of Maharashtra's poorer regions and has long been the part of the state furthest from a good road. This link puts it on the expressway network.

relatedRoads.label: The Mumbai–Nagpur expressway this branch joins at Jalna

travelNotes: Opening in stages as sections are finished. Until then the drive to Nanded uses the older state highways through Parbhani.
